t: Greetings on Interior Ministry Personnel Day
d: The President congratulated veterans, personnel and civilian staff of the Interior Ministry on Interior Ministry Personnel Day.

t: Greetings to the participants, guests, and organisers of the International Collective Security Forum
d: Vladimir Putin sent greetings to the participants, guests, and organisers of the International Collective Security Forum.

t: Greetings to the 50th Young Specialist – Builder of the Future Forum
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to the participants of the 50th Young Specialist – Builder of the Future Forum, held in Kazan as part of BRICS Construction Week.

t: Birthday greetings to Alexander Gintsburg, Research Director at Gamaleya National Centre for Epidemiology and Microbiology
d: Vladimir Putin sent congratulated full member of the Russian Academy of Sciences, Research Director of the Gamaleya National Centre for Epidemiology and Microbiology Alexander Gintsburg on his 75th birthday.
